title: VerificationResult
description: Standard output for the Mathematical Verification Layer

valid.description: True if the mathematical check passes

expression.description: The parsed or normalized expression that was checked

expected.description: The expected result or symbolic form

confidence.description: Confidence level of the verifier (e.g., 1.0 for exact arithmetic, 0.5 for regex fallback)

location.description: Where the error occurred in the expression

explanation.description: Clear explanation of the mathematical error

suggested_next_step.description: Hint for the tutor to provide the student
